summary: Restore copy-on-write for Status payload updates and erasures.
explanation: The failures share a copy-on-write defect in two paths. In Status.CopyAssignmentIsNotRef, status_copy.SetPayload(kUrl1, ...) must leave status_orig unchanged, so the statuses compare unequal; they compare equal because SetPayload mutates their shared StatusRep. In Status.Equality, adding a second payload to two_payloads must leave one_payload unchanged; the failed comparisons show both statuses instead have equal payloads. In Status.CopyOnWriteForErasePayload, erasing kUrl1 from the returned copy must preserve base.GetPayload(kUrl1), and erasing from base must preserve copy.GetPayload(kUrl1); both expressions are false because CloneAndUnref treats a rep with two references as unique. Route SetPayload through PrepareToModify and clone whenever the rep has more than one reference. This restores independent mutation while retaining the in-place path for a uniquely owned rep.
